narrative: I replayed the known 33-action level-1 prefix, then explored level 2 solely through rendered grids, returned completion counters, and action outcomes. Level 2 has a timed vertical target with multiple 4x4 slots, five outlined blocks, and a moving solid object; ACTION1-ACTION4 move the player, while ACTION5 picks up or drops an adjacent highlighted block. I confirmed that blocks can be carried over target slots and must be explicitly dropped, but several partial placements and automatically moving visual overlaps left levels_completed at 1. The immediate-verification rule caught those unconfirmed-overlap theories on the very next returned frames, so I re-observed and revised instead of claiming success. One exploratory route expired the level timer; a free reset preserved the level-1 checkpoint, but the corrected retry still did not complete level 2 before I stopped at 142 of 150 allowed env.step calls. No winning sequence was found, so the reproduction gate was not run.
